theme: Stacking chips without cooking the middle one
title: Stacking Chips Without Cooking the Middle One: TSV Thermal Via Placement
strategies: no vias anywhere, spend zero of the area budget (trivial baseline)
rank columns by the TOPMOST die's own power reading divided by area cost, fill the budget greedily by that value-density (greedy, the obvious per-die + fractional-knapsack recipe)

compute the depth-weighted stacked hotspot profile W[c] = sum_m m*p[m][c] across the whole stack, via the highest-W columns first while affordable (strong, exploits vertical-heat-path + hotspot-coupling and the min-max shape of the objective)
true joint optimum over (partition-free) via sets under adversarial, non-monotone cost structure (open ceiling, uncovered)
